title: Flask is in no requirements file, so `cura webhook` cannot start
method: read both requirements files and probed the installed venv
observed_at_discovery: 'flask' appears in neither requirements-core.txt (twilio, APScheduler) nor requirements.txt, and `.venv/bin/python -c 'import flask'` fails after install.sh. create_app raises ImportError without it. The webhook is the only code path that receives 'press 2 if you need help' and the speech transcript, so after a by-the-book install the listening half of Cura cannot be run at all.
